findings.pdf_says: The whole of section 3.4 (heading through "DATE-COMPILED. current date.") is printed inside one level-2 box, including the general format "DATE-COMPILED. [comment-entry] ..." and the replacement form "DATE-COMPILED. current date."
findings.markdown_says: <u>DATE-COMPILED</u>. [ comment-entry ] …  /  DATE-COMPILED. current date.  (both <pre> blocks carry no ║ level-2 box markers, while every other paragraph of 3.4 does)
findings.why_it_matters: The level-2 box markers are dropped from the two <pre> blocks inside the boxed 3.4; page 237 keeps ║ on its boxed general format, so the transcription's own convention marks them. Low impact: the surrounding heading and prose carry the markers.
